{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')
else:
    data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]
    print(f"Dropped {len(qa_orders)} QA orders.")

# Now, do NOT drop refunded orders — per contract, the population is ALL orders from loyal customers
# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_data = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of loyal customer orders (including refunded): {len(loyal_data)}")

# Compute conversion rate over all loyal customer orders, including refunded ones
converted_count = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(loyal_data)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
